claims.statement: Allocation rule v18 (live 22:00, east-node-first reservation) triggered split-reservation exceptions that stalled east-node orders in 'awaiting pickup' state
claims.corroboration: v18 is the only production change since last week; all stuck orders are on east-node lanes and flagged as split-reservation exceptions; timing aligns with v18 live time plus allocation window lag
claims.limitation: Not yet discriminated from carrier-feed lag or inventory-count drift hypotheses; rule change review passed and regression suite was green, but real-world behavior differs

claims.statement: Impact: 186 orders (9% of overnight allocations) held in 'awaiting pickup' for >90 minutes, east-node only, generating customer support reports
claims.corroboration: Monitor alert confirms 9% metric; support report indicates continuous arrival of complaints
claims.limitation: Total customer impact (SLA violations, revenue risk) not yet quantified; proxy count (support contacts) is incomplete

next_action.rationale: Discriminating evidence: understand the exception pattern in v18. Are split-reservation exceptions unique to east-node, unique to v18, and what do their details reveal about the reservation logic failure?
next_action.expected_information_gain: Exception pattern will confirm/disprove allocation_rule_defect vs other causes (carrier lag, inventory drift)
